CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2548 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head f2f204fc3ed608a69b56ee9ebc0c2eee23e74dc1. Bus nonce: 2246ae046f7e4d4683a374de41c516aa. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin f2f204fc3ed608a69b56ee9ebc0c2eee23e74dc1`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge f2f204fc3ed608a69b56ee9ebc0c2eee23e74dc1` or `Fix review: blocked f2f204fc3ed608a69b56ee9ebc0c2eee23e74dc1 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 2246ae046f7e4d4683a374de41c516aa`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2548 f2f204fc3ed608a69b56ee9ebc0c2eee23e74dc1") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2548-2246ae04`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer for PR #2548. Round 2: the previous review blocked an earlier head; read the last "Fix review:" comment on the PR, then verify this head resolves each blocking item, measured with the finder harness the group brief names (roster: origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster, jq), never the fixer harness. The fixer's round-2 body is in the PR. A red nightly-status grades main and is not this PR unless its diff reaches what that check reads. Your ev/ MUST contain a file holding the full 40-hex head sha (ev/HEAD.txt).
